signin.headline:
Every tool.
One login.
signin.lead: Orbit puts your tools in one place. Sign in once with Microsoft – your role decides what you see.
signin.hint: External partners sign in with the account the invitation was sent to.

errors.AccessDenied: Orbit isn't enabled for this account. Ask your administrator for access.
errors.Configuration: Sign-in isn't set up correctly. Check the Entra app registration and environment variables.

header.appCount: {count, plural, =0 {No apps in your orbit yet} =1 {1 app in your orbit} other {# apps in your orbit}}

dashboard.dragHint: Move tiles by their handle to arrange them.
dashboard.dragPaused: Sorting is paused while searching or filtering.
dashboard.saveError: Layout not saved. Check your connection and move the tile again.
dashboard.noResultsCategory: There's no app for you in this category.
dashboard.emptyBody: Your account doesn't have any apps assigned yet. Ask your administrator to give you the right roles.

dnd.instructions: Press space or enter to pick up a tile. Use the arrow keys to move it, space or enter to drop it, and escape to cancel.

welcome.ready: {count, plural, =0 {Your orbit is ready} =1 {1 app ready to go} other {# apps ready to go}}

request.title: Request access
request.intro: Pick an app. Your administrator gets your request by email and enables your access.
request.messagePlaceholder: What do you need the app for?
request.successBody: You'll get a confirmation by email. Once approved, the app appears the next time you sign in.

errors.rate_limited: You've sent several requests in the last hour. Try again later.
errors.already_requested: You already have an open request for this app.
errors.mail_not_configured: Requests aren't set up yet. Contact your administrator directly.
errors.default: The request wasn't sent. Try again.

shell.passError: The connection to Orbit was interrupted. Reload the page or sign in again.

noAccess.title: No access to Offers
noAccess.body: This app needs the App.Offerten role. Ask your administrator or request access from the dashboard.

overview.title: Offers
overview.lead: Review drafts from demo calls, adjust them and send them right away.

empty.drafts: No open drafts. New ones appear here automatically after a demo call where the prospect asks for an offer.

calls.lead: The latest Fireflies calls with external participants. If no offer request was detected, you can still create an offer.
calls.error: Fireflies isn't reachable or not set up yet.
calls.empty: No calls with external participants found.

newDialog.title: New offer
newDialog.intro: Start from a GHL contact so the recipient, language and opportunity are filled in right away.
newDialog.ghlUnavailable: GHL isn't connected. You can still start blank.
newDialog.ghlWrongLocation: GHL denies access: the token doesn't belong to the Elev8 sub-account. Details under Prices & settings → Connections.
newDialog.ghlFailed: GHL can't be reached right now. Details under Prices & settings → Connections.
newDialog.creating: Creating the offer, Noah is writing the texts …

editor.sentHint: Sent offers stay unchanged. To make a new version, copy it as a draft.

recipient.title: Recipient
recipient.ghlNotLinked: No GHL contact linked. Without a contact the offer won't be filed in GHL.
recipient.name: Name
recipient.countryHint: E.g. CH, DE, AT. Controls the VAT note.
recipient.reverseChargeHint: Reverse charge: a note appears on the offer.

lines.title: Line items
lines.autoHint: Quantity and price come from the package. The discount is up to you.
lines.empty: No line items yet. Pick a package above or add a line item.

texts.title: Texts
texts.regenerateError: The texts couldn't be written. Try again.
texts.regenerateConfirm: Introduction, discussion points, closing and email will be rewritten. Your edits to them will be lost. Continue?
texts.mailHint: Suggested when sending, where you can adjust it again.
texts.emailFallback: Leave empty for the default text

preview.xlsxHint: This is how the Excel file looks. Quantity and discount stay editable in Excel and the amounts recalculate.

sendDialog.title: Send offer
sendDialog.subject: Subject
sendDialog.viaResend: via Orbit, replies go to you
sendDialog.notConfigured: Email sending isn't set up yet.
sendDialog.ghlHint: Afterwards the offer is filed with the GHL contact and the opportunity is updated.
sendDialog.ghlNoContact: No GHL contact linked: the offer won't be filed in GHL.

errors.invalid: Enter valid email addresses, a subject and a message, and pick at least one format.
errors.already_sent: This offer has already been sent.
errors.mail_not_configured: Email sending isn't set up yet.
errors.no_lines: The offer has no line items.

settings.title: Prices & settings
settings.lead: Applies to all new offers, and to drafts as soon as you change their package. Sent offers stay unchanged.
settings.readOnly: Only editable with the App.Offerten.Admin role.
settings.resetConfirm: Reset all fields to the Elev8 default prices? Nothing is stored until you click “Save”.
settings.reverseChargeHint: ISO codes, comma-separated, e.g. DE, AT
settings.assistantHint: Shown on every offer in the “Questions?” box and mentioned by Noah in the cover email.

follow.lead: Sent offers with their next follow-up date. Noah suggests a personal follow-up email; it's sent from your mailbox.
follow.ghlFailed: Saved, but not updated in GHL: {detail}

followUp.title: Follow up with {name}
followUp.drafting: Noah is drafting a suggestion from the call and history …
followUp.subject: Subject
followUp.hint: Sent from your mailbox and filed in GHL as a note. The next date is set automatically.
followUp.draftFailed: No suggestion available. Write the message yourself or try again later.
followUp.invalid: Enter valid email addresses, a subject and a message.
